claim: Oxbow Public Market is a 40,000-sq-ft food hall at 610 & 644 First St, Napa, open daily 7am-9pm with owner-operated local vendors and an outdoor deck on the Napa River.
quote: The local Gathering place for great food & wine in Napa Valley

claim: Oxbow Public Market vendors include Gott's Roadside, Eiko's sushi, El Porteno Empanadas and Hudson Greens & Goods, with live music, tastings and a farmers market.

The Napa Valley Wine Train departs from 1275 McKinstry Street, Napa, offering daytime, evening multi-course dinner, six-hour Legacy, and seasonal journeys in refurbished Pullman cars; reservations required via Check Availability.
quote: Multi-course gourmet meals, afternoon teas, and Michelin-inspired tastings are paired with stunning views and personalized service.

claim: The Wine Train runs a 36-mile, ~3-hour round trip from Napa to St. Helena through Yountville, Oakville and Rutherford; lunch trips start near $200/person and daylong tours can exceed $700.
quote: Ticket prices start around $200 per person for a lunch trip during the off season, and can exceed $700 per person for daylong tours.

claim: Downtown Napa on the Napa River has been reinvented with celebrity-chef restaurants, riverside parks and walks, and dozens of walkable tasting rooms.
quote: An influx of celebrity-chef restaurants, upscale lodgings, manicured parks and river walks, and dozens of tasting rooms have redefined the area as a luxury destination.

claim: More than 20 downtown Napa tasting rooms are within walking distance, including Robert Mondavi Arch & Tower, The River Club, and Vintner's Collective in a restored 19th-century stone building.
quote: There are more than 20 tasting rooms, all within walking distance of the Napa River Inn.

claim: di Rosa Center for Contemporary Art is open Friday-Sunday 11am-4pm (last admission 3:30); admission is $25 general, $20 senior/student/military, $5 ages 5-17, free under 5; guided tours offered Fri-Sun at 11am.
quote: Friday – Sunday 11 a.m. – 4 p.m. ... General: $25 ... Minors (5–17): $5 ... Members and children under 5: Free

claim: di Rosa sits on 217 acres at 5200 Sonoma Hwy in Carneros with over 1,600 Northern California artworks, two indoor galleries, a large outdoor sculpture meadow, a 35-acre lake and walking trails.
quote: the site features multiple galleries, a sculpture park, and a 35-acre lake, all located on 217 scenic acres

claim: CIA at Copia in Napa's Oxbow District (500 First Street) offers hands-on cooking and beverage classes, The Grove garden-to-table restaurant, self-service wine bar, marketplace, and the Chuck Williams Culinary Arts Museum.
quote: The Grove Restaurant featuring locally sourced, chef-driven cuisine ... Chuck Williams Culinary Arts Museum ... Wine Bar - Self-service wine tastings available throughout the property

claim: Napa Premium Outlets (629 Factory Stores Dr) is open daily 11am-7pm with extended hours during the November-January holiday season.
quote: Napa Premium Outlets regular hours of operation are Monday through Sunday, 11:00 AM - 7:00 PM.
